content.value_statement: Deep research can be slow when one agent explores every source in sequence. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users toward a 10-agent parallel research workflow.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use parallelized research for broad topics.
Describes a 10-agent research workflow for distributed investigation.
Directs users to the upstream Infinite Gratitude repository for setup.
Supports research gathering and synthesis across multiple agents.
Provides source attribution for the external project.
limitations: The local skill file is a wrapper and does not include the full workflow implementation.
Users must review the external repository before installing or running it.
Research quality depends on the agents, prompts, and sources used.
It does not verify facts or cite sources automatically from this file alone.

use_cases.title: Market Research Sprint
use_cases.description: Analyze a market, competitors, pricing, and customer needs in parallel before summarizing findings.

use_cases.title: Technical Landscape Review
use_cases.description: Divide a technical topic into subquestions and compare approaches across independent research tracks.

use_cases.title: Evidence Gathering
use_cases.description: Collect multiple perspectives on a policy, trend, or case study before preparing a balanced synthesis.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Research Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a broad topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Infinite Gratitude to research this topic in parallel: [topic]. Split the work into clear subquestions and summarize the final findings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use a parallel research workflow to compare [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Cover strengths, risks, costs, and recommended next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Source-Backed Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] using parallel agents. Require each track to collect source-backed evidence, note uncertainty, and produce a concise executive brief.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Case Study Investigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research with scoped agent roles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Infinite Gratitude for a case study on [organization or event]. Assign agent roles for timeline, stakeholders, strategy, outcomes, risks, and lessons learned.

output_examples.input: Research the market for privacy-focused note-taking apps.
output_examples.output: A structured brief with competitor groups, customer segments, feature patterns, pricing observations, risks, and recommended follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Compare three database options for an analytics product.
output: A side-by-side comparison of architecture fit, operations burden, cost drivers, and scaling limits.
A short recommendation with assumptions and unresolved research gaps.

output_examples.input: Investigate a public company case study.
output_examples.output: A synthesized report covering timeline, strategic choices, external context, measurable outcomes, and lessons for similar teams.

best_practices: Define research questions before assigning parallel agent tracks.
Ask agents to separate evidence, assumptions, and open questions.
Synthesize results into one brief with clear citations and confidence levels.
anti_patterns: Do not use parallel agents for a narrow question that one search can answer.
Do not merge findings without resolving conflicts between agent outputs.
Do not install or run the external repository without reviewing its current contents.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps organize broad research into parallel tracks so results can be gathered and synthesized faster.

faq.question: Does this local skill include the full implementation?
faq.answer: No. The local file points users to the upstream repository for installation and detailed usage.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for technical research?
faq.answer: No. It can support market, policy, product, and case study research when the topic can be divided into subquestions.

faq.question: How should I check the final answer?
faq.answer: Review cited evidence, compare conflicting findings, and ask for uncertainty notes before making decisions.

faq.question: Does it browse the web by itself?
faq.answer: This file does not perform browsing. Any web access depends on the external workflow and the tools available in your environment.
